I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47.

Pree posted Dock 23 in #central-team on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same day because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel has changed it since. Hollis is in #central-team, so all of this is something he can see himself.
